summary: HttpStatusCode.PayloadTooLarge (413) is deprecated in favor of the new HttpStatusCode.ContentTooLarge
HttpStatusCode.UnprocessableEntity (422) is deprecated in favor of the new HttpStatusCode.UnprocessableContent
With the fetch adapter maxRedirects: 0 now prevents redirects from being followed (manual redirect mode, exposing the 3xx or an opaque redirect) instead of being ignored
NO_PROXY entries now accept IPv4 and IPv6 CIDR ranges, so 0.0.0.0/0 or ::/0 bypass the proxy for every destination where such entries previously matched nothing
data: URIs whose media type contains extra slash separators now reject with ERR_INVALID_URL instead of being parsed

A custom fetch implementation (env.fetch) now gets method, headers, body, signal, duplex and credentials only on the resolved Request (first argument); those fields are no longer on the second fetchOptions argument, where custom implementations used to read them
An explicit proxy config combined with httpVersion 2 now rejects with ERR_NOT_SUPPORT instead of being silently ignored (request sent directly)
Config fields inherited from an Object.create(null) template object (a config whose prototype is a null-prototype object) are now ignored, where they used to be honored
Interceptor manager replacement objects that need sanitizing are now stored as normalized null-prototype snapshots, losing their original identity, prototype, instanceof branding and accessors
